name: The Greater Lands
description: The great continent, also called the Great Lands.

name: The Dells
description: Rolling dells between the coast and the mountains: good farming country. Terrain die 2.

name: The Black Dunes
description:
Volcanic sands, highly rich in ore. Terrain die 4.

On the world globe (pole 50.27°E 10°S, seam 150°E 50°S, south compression 0.5, E/W 0.55), remapped Burgas sits at about 27.4°N 10.6°W. The globe is tilted: climate follows a hot axis, not in-world latitude, and measured from that axis this area sits at a climate latitude of about 46°, much colder than its 27°N suggests. That makes it cold, at the edge of the ice belt, and moderately dry, since much of what lies within 8° is land. On the globe's overlay it reads as pale, cold steppe or moorland, partly whitened by ice. Real east now points west-north-west here, so the real Black Sea coast faces west. Physically, think of the Kamchatka Peninsula: volcanoes, glaciers and black volcanic sand, though drier.

name: Volcano, Valleys and Glaciers
description: Snow-capped mountains around an active volcano, cut by glaciers and valleys. When it snows here, the flakes are warm and dry. Terrain die 6.

name: The Sea
description: The sea to the west of the Dells.

name: Fist of Glass
description: A cluster of rocks off the western coast.

name: Forest of Arrows
description: Dense forest along the north-western coast.

name: Great Stone Face
description: A landmark in the mountains north-east of the Dells.

name: Dead Aqueduct
description: A stone aqueduct bridge over the river.

name: Ancient Channel
description: Unexplained phenomena: a braided web of channels spreading south of the [[Dead Aqueduct]].

name: The Farmlands
description: Small fields on the coastal plain south of the dunes. Terrain die 3.

name: The Freti
description: The channels between the [[Inner Sea]] and the [[Bay of Brael]], the way from the Inner Sea to the [[Gulf of Ages]]. In the projection: the Kattegat and the Skagerrak.

name: The Gulf of Ages
description: The ocean beyond the [[Bay of Brael]]: harsh and inhospitable, and second to the [[Inner Sea]] for maritime trade. In the projection: the Arctic Ocean.

name: The Bay of Brael
description: The bay between the [[Freti]] and the [[Gulf of Ages]]. In the projection: the North Sea.

name: The Inner Sea
description: The sheltered sea within the [[Freti]], and the first sea for maritime trade. In the projection: the Baltic.

name: The Mound
description: A steep, rocky mound near the head of a sea lough. In the projection: in Belfast.

name: The Lagan Estuary
description: The tidal channel of the Lagan, deep enough for ships, from the head of the lough up to the weir by [[the Mound]]. In the projection: the Lagan below its weir and the Victoria Channel.

name: Tor Ruiait
description: A steep-sided mesa standing out of the plain, its top a flat table a few km across, broken off in scarps on every side. In the projection: at Moscow.
